900001.title: Lone Pine
900001.extract: Lone Pine is a small town in the Owens Valley of the Eastern Sierra, at the foot of Mount Whitney.

900002.title: Alabama Hills
900002.extract: The Alabama Hills are a range of rounded rock outcrops west of Lone Pine.

900003.title: Eastern Sierra
900003.extract: The Eastern Sierra is the region along US 395 below the crest of the Sierra Nevada.
